# Sudz Up Detailing LLC

> Professional interior and exterior auto detailing in Hartford, Wisconsin, serving Hartford and the surrounding Washington County area.

## Business
- Name: Sudz Up Detailing LLC
- Address: 2948 WI-83, Hartford, WI 53027, United States
- Phone / Text: 414-286-1609
- Email: SudzUpdetail2025@outlook.com
- Website: https://sudzupdetail.com/
- Hours: Monday-Sunday, 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM
- Vehicle types: cars, trucks, SUVs

## Packages
- Sudz Quick Clean - $135 (cars) / $150 (SUVs & trucks).
  Interior vacuum, vinyl/rubber/plastic (VRP) treatment, spot stain removal,
  door jambs cleaned, windows cleaned.
- Sudz Up VIP Clean - $200 (cars) / $250 (SUVs & trucks).
  Everything in the Quick Clean plus exterior wash and polish, wheels cleaned,
  tires shined.

Prices may vary based on vehicle condition and service requirements.

## Service area
Hartford, Slinger, Richfield, West Bend, Jackson, Allenton, Germantown,
Kewaskum, Colgate and Erin (Washington County, WI); Rubicon and Neosho
(Dodge County, WI).
